title: Apple and Amazon Accused of Being Digital Bedfellows
summary: Connecticut Attorney General Richard Blumenthal announced an investigation into Apple Inc. and Amazon.com Inc., accusing them of making agreements that deter publishers from offering lower e-book prices to competitors. Blumenthal states these agreements hurt competition and hopes to discuss the matter with representatives from both companies. Apple declined to comment, and Amazon did not immediately return messages.

title: Williams-Sonoma needs to tweak its recipe
summary: Williams-Sonoma's CEO, Laura J. Alber, faces the challenge of boosting sales following a housing slump, with her strategy focusing on expanding the West Elm brand and increasing online sales. The company aims to capture market share by appealing to homeowners renovating existing properties and leveraging its strong online presence, despite facing competition from rivals like Crate & Barrel. Analysts highlight the potential for West Elm and the company's "Amazon-proof" exclusive merchandise as key strengths, though challenges remain in finding prime store locations and integrating new brands.
